question: How many days of leave do I have?
expected_answer: Depends: 24 days for full-time, pro rata for part-time (e.g. 12 days for 20 h/week), plus 1 extra day per 5 years of service up to 27; special leave is separate.
answer:
Full-time employees receive **24 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year [Leave Policy, HR-POL-004, section 2].

Part-time employees receive leave in proportion to their contracted hours (for example, an employee working 20 hours per week receives 12 days) [Leave Policy, HR-POL-004, section 2].

Employees who join during the year receive a pro-rata entitlement from their start date, rounded up to the nearest half day [Leave Policy, HR-POL-004, section 2]. 

Additionally, after **5 years** of continuous service, employees receive **1 extra day** for every additional 5 years of service, up to a maximum of **27 days** per year [Leave Policy, HR-POL-004, section 2]. During the probation period (first 90 days), employees may take **up to 5 days** of annual leave with the approval of their line manager [Onboarding Guide for New Employees, HR-GUI-002, section 5].

To give you the exact number of days that apply to you, could you please let me know your employment status (full-time, part-time, or during your probation period) and your length of service at Contoso Business Services?
judge_reason: The assistant correctly identifies that the answer depends on the user's situation, explains the various annual leave entitlements (full-time, part-time, length of service, and probation period) based on the provided documents, and asks clarifying questions to provide a precise answer.
